description: The number of binary partitions of n, partitions into powers of two. b(0) is 1. Odd n copies b(n-1). Even n is b(n-1) plus b(n/2). b(1) is 1, b(4) is 4, and b(10) is 14. n runs from 0 to 1000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/binary-partition
